notes: Three taḥwīl routes; the names after the last «قالا حدثنا» are written once: شعبة (second occurrence), قتادة, أنس, which form the shared tail
«حدثنا أبي ح» leaves شعبة unwritten in the first route; the tail carries it for all three
«- يعني ابن الحارث -» is a gloss, left out

fixes.reason: the words for «أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم» run together and the Prophet's name is lost
